current_text: Couldn't start EZLM's engine.
problem: Says what failed but not what to do next; the failure screen offers Try again and the text never names it.
proposed_text: Couldn't start EZLM's engine. Try again, or reinstall EZLM if it keeps happening.

current_text: EZLM's engine didn't start within 30 seconds. Your antivirus may be scanning it; try again in a moment.
problem: Semicolon joins two sentences and the second starts lower case, so it reads as one run-on.
proposed_text: EZLM's engine didn't start within 30 seconds. Your antivirus may be scanning it. Try again in a moment.

current_text: EZLM's engine stopped while starting. Your antivirus may have blocked it.
problem: Names a likely cause but no next action.
proposed_text: EZLM's engine stopped while starting. Your antivirus may have blocked it. Try again, or add EZLM to your antivirus exceptions.

current_text: Request failed (404)
problem: Bare HTTP jargon, shown on the full-screen failure page when the engine sends no error text; no next action.
proposed_text: EZLM's engine couldn't complete that request (HTTP 404). Try again, and report the problem if it keeps happening.

current_text: EZLM's background engine stopped unexpectedly. Your model server keeps running; Try again reconnects to it.
problem: Capital letter after a semicolon and a button label folded into the sentence, so it reads as two broken sentences.
proposed_text: EZLM's background engine stopped unexpectedly. Your model server keeps running. Press Try again to reconnect to it.

current_text: This page hit a problem and couldn't be shown.
problem: No next action; the raw exception message follows with no explanation.
proposed_text: This page hit a problem and couldn't be shown. Press Try again, or copy the details for support.

current_text: You can also cancel and free up space yourself.
problem: 'cancel' does not name the Cancel button, and the sentence does not say to come back and try again.
proposed_text: You can also press Cancel, free up space yourself, then try again.

current_text: {model} is back and loading; it'll answer in a minute.
problem: Semicolon plus a contraction; voice rules ask for plain sentences.
proposed_text: {model} is back and loading. It will answer in a minute.

current_text: Setup failed.
problem: Two words with no cause and no next action; it replaces the engine's own message when that is empty.
proposed_text: Setup failed. Try again, and press Report this problem if it keeps happening.

current_text: Closing apps you're not using gives your AI more memory. EZLM asks about each one; nothing closes without your OK.
problem: Semicolon and 'OK'; the second sentence is reassurance rather than a next action.
proposed_text: Closing apps you're not using gives your AI more memory. EZLM asks about each one before closing it.

current_text: {app.Name} is still running (it may have asked to save something, or it keeps going in the background).
problem: Bracketed aside holding two unrelated guesses; hard to read at a glance.
proposed_text: {app.Name} is still running. It may be waiting for you to save something, or it keeps running in the background.

current_text: {X} of that was graphics memory, the most valuable kind for AI.
problem: Marketing flavour ('the most valuable kind') and no next action.
proposed_text: {X} of that was graphics memory, which the model can use.

current_text: Couldn't read the log: {message}
problem: No next action; the toast disappears after four seconds.
proposed_text: Couldn't read the log: {message} Try again.

current_text: This posts on EZLM's public GitHub page, where the people testing EZLM read it. Thanks for helping.
problem: Chatty sign-off and no next action; it never says what to write or that the text is public and cannot be edited after posting.
proposed_text: This posts on EZLM's public GitHub page. Write what happened, then press Send report.

current_text: Sent. Thank you! (report #{n})
problem: Exclamation mark and thanks; the voice rules ban exclamation marks.
proposed_text: Sent as report #{n}.

current_text: Couldn't send the report: {message}
problem: No next action and no way to keep the report the user just typed.
proposed_text: Couldn't send the report: {message} Try again, or copy the text so you can post it yourself.

current_text: The server didn't accept EZLM's key. Restart EZLM; if it keeps happening, report a problem.
problem: Semicolon, and 'report a problem' does not name the Report a problem button.
proposed_text: The server didn't accept EZLM's key. Restart EZLM. If it keeps happening, press Report a problem.

current_text: Your model answered with an error ({code}): {message}
problem: Passes llama-server's raw message through with no next action.
proposed_text: Your model answered with an error ({code}): {message}. Try again, and press Report a problem if it keeps happening.

current_text: Something went wrong: {message}
problem: Generic prefix, raw exception text, no next action.
proposed_text: Something went wrong: {message}. Try again.

current_text: This computer has no voice for reading aloud (add one in Windows Settings > Time & language > Speech).
problem: Bracketed aside; the path is written with a > arrow instead of words.
proposed_text: This computer has no voice for reading aloud. Add one in Windows Settings, under Time and language, Speech.

current_text: Couldn't open the folder picker: {message}
problem: No next action.
proposed_text: Couldn't open the folder picker: {message} Try again.

current_text: Couldn't change where models are saved.
problem: No next action and no hint that the old folder still works.
proposed_text: Couldn't change where models are saved. Try again, or keep the current folder.

current_text: Couldn't start the installer: {message}
problem: No next action.
proposed_text: Couldn't start the installer: {message} Download the update again from Settings.

current_text: no exceptions
problem: Check name is a fragment that only makes sense after FAIL; the next catch uses a different style.
proposed_text: chat logic ran without an error

current_text: apps: no exceptions
problem: Second spelling of the same check name; reads as a fragment in the PASS/FAIL output.
proposed_text: app checks ran without an error
